passed.result: Each advance performs at most one platform read and persists one safe boundary. The coordinator does not own resource leases or create a second scheduler.
Structured SQLite checkpoints, content-addressed images, evidence references, crash recovery, and completed replay were verified across a closed and reopened runtime.

Authority is checked before the connector read, around staged-file verification, and again inside the SQLite commit transaction. Recovery retains session, instance, and job ownership while requiring a higher epoch and new token.

The executable path is ConnectorCommand NDJSON to ConnectorResult NDJSON, strict correlation, command-scoped staging verification, typed result decoding, CAS persistence, and SQLite reference/checkpoint commit.

Each command removes its own verified staging in a finally boundary. Runtime startup recovers safe orphan command directories while retaining active commands and refusing unknown, nested, symlink, or reparse entries.
There is one ChengfengStage definition, no connector next_job_status, no platform write or generic request API, no network client dependency, and no real Chengfeng access path.
